Not sent, and this message was not paid for. You accepted this contact\'s new key and your own key exchange for it is sent or still waiting to go. Shielded messages in this chat wait until it finishes, up to an hour after it is sent, even if their answer arrives sooner. After that, tap Accept when ZChat asks (it shows the price; if you allowed handshake transactions it may pay this one answer by itself), then send again.

Not sent: this contact\'s security key changed, so ZChat stops every send in this chat until you decide about their new key. Nothing was sent or paid. First compare your safety number with them (Verify shows the number of their NEW key). Then tap Accept the new key on this warning. In a Shielded chat that is free unless their phone also needs your key; then ZChat first asks you to pay for one on-chain message and shows the price. In a Tunnel chat ZChat first asks you to pay for a reconnect (up to 2 on-chain messages) and shows the price.

Not sent: this contact\'s security key changed, so ZChat stops every send in this chat until you accept the new key. Nothing was sent or paid. First compare your safety number with them (Verify). This contact\'s security key changed. It could be a new device, or someone trying to impersonate them. Their new key first reached you: %1$s. Tap Verify to see its safety number and compare it with them. Until you decide, none of your messages are sent and nothing is paid in this chat.
Accept this contact\'s new key?

Compare the safety number below with what they tell you in person or over a channel you already trust. Accept the key only if the number matches exactly. If you accept it, your messages in this chat are encrypted to that key from now on, and the chat shows as unverified until you compare safety numbers. If their key did not really change (for example after you updated ZChat), the number will not match: tap Not their key. Close changes nothing.
